title: INS Tabar Mediterranean exercise location
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Mediterranean Sea highlighting the Port of Naples where INS Tabar conducted its exercise.
altText: A detailed map of the Mediterranean Sea on a white background, showing the coastlines of Europe, Africa, and Asia with accurate colors. The Port of Naples is marked by a bright red star and labeled "Port of Naples (INS Tabar exercise site)". A small navy ship icon and a dashed line indicate the route and exercise area of INS Tabar. A compass rose is placed in the upper right corner, and a scale bar runs across the bottom of the map. All elements are clearly labelled and rendered in high resolution.
